figure_candidates.label: Figure 1
figure_candidates.caption:
Figure 1. MassQL workflow for amino acid annotation (A) MassQL
query for endolides. Example MassQL query for the specific search for
the methylated (dark blue) and unmethylated (light blue) iminium
ions of 3-(3-furyl)-alanine and valine (green) are highlighted. (B)
Visualization of MassQL query in MS/MS data of endolide B. (C)
Indicative MS/MS hooks in endolide B, iminium adducts of amino
acids (N-methyl-3-(3-furyl)-alanine, 3-(3-furyl)-alanine, and valine).
(D) Results of MassQL queries focusing on occurring amino acids.
Valine and leucine/isoleucine were combined, as it is not possible to
distinguish between N-methyl-valine and leucine/isoleucine by
analysis of the iminium adducts only.

figure_candidates.label: Figure 5
figure_candidates.caption:
Figure 5. Two-digit micromolar concentrations of endolide F (2) inhibit arginine vasopressin (AVP)-induced activation of the vasopressin V1A
receptor (V1AR). Concentration-dependent whole cell activation of naïve HEK293 cells after transfection with empty vector or an expression
plasmid coding for the V1A receptor following application of AVP (A, B) or endolide F (C, D). (B, D) Concentration−effect relationships of the
traces shown in A and C expressed as a percentage of the 1 μM AVP response obtained on V1A-receptor-transfected cells in each individual
experiment, with the stippled line indicating the EC80 value. (E) Effect of endolide F on whole cell activation evoked with AVP or carbachol (CCh)
at their respective EC80 concentrations in HEK293 cells transfected to transiently express the V1A receptor. (F) Concentration−effect relationship
of the traces depicted in E expressed as the normalized reduction of the maximal DMR response caused by AVP or CCh alone in each individual
experiment. Representative single traces are buffer-corrected means + standard error of the mean (S.E.M.) of three replicate measurements.
Concentration−effect relationships are means ± S.E.M. of at least three independent biological experiments, each performed in technical triplicate.
Δpm, buffer-corrected wavelength shift in picometers. DMR, dynamic mass redistribution.
